title: Kindness Luigi Happy Ghast
description: Turns the Happy Ghast to Kindness Luigi
body:
Changes the Happy Ghast into Kindness Luigi from [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80zmPlZwn5U). I had this idea a few months ago and finally decided to make it real.

Also changes the normal Ghast into mario and the 'Tears' music disk to the song from the video.
